Spends most of the time collecting dust on a Japantown Fixer’s desk. Except for the occasional heated negotiation. As a reward for victory, it blesses its wielder with the speed of a sacred beast.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Renzokuken (See Special Features)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: If the user has moved at least 6m/yds this turn, they are able to make a Leaping Strike that sends the user 4m/yds forward to attack a target with fierce speed. This takes up half of the weapon’s ROF 2, does not consume MOVE, and deals 4d6 damage if successful.

When this weapon is used to kill a target, meaning one of its attacks brings a target to 0 HP or lower, then the user feels sacred power flow through their veins for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds). During this time, they are capable of making a special ROF 1 Renzokuken Attack, which cannot be an Aimed Shot and cannot be done during a Grapple.

Renzokuken: The user makes a Melee Weapons Attack Check at a -4 penalty against the target’s Evasion. If they succeed, they roll 3d6, dropping the lowest die, and multiply the total result by the amount they beat the target’s Evasion Check by, up to a maximum equal to half (Round Up) their Melee Weapons Skill Level.

If the user misses their Renzokuken attack, they must spend an Action on their next turn to recover from the wild flailing before they can make any other Action. Successful Renzokuken Attacks count as hitting a target with two Melee Weapon Attacks for the purposes of Martial Arts Special Moves prerequisites.

EX: A character with DEX 8 and Melee Weapons Level 7 (Maximum x4 multiplier) attempts a Renzokuken attack. They roll a 5 on their Check, for a total result of 16 (due to the -4) against their target’s result of 13. The user rolls 3d6 (Drop Lowest), getting 10 [5, 5, 2]. The target’s Evasion Check was beaten by 3, resulting in a final damage total of 30 (10x3) before interacting with the target’s armor, which is still halved as normal for a Melee Weapon Attack. Ouch!

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Melee
Alt. fire: Renzokuken (See Special Features)

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
